name: Atal Bhujal Yojana
benefit:
- The scheme provides an overall financial outlay of ₹60,00,00,00,000/- over five years, which includes ₹30,00,00,00,000/- as a loan from the World Bank and ₹30,00,00,00,000/- as a matching contribution from the Government of India.
- The Institutional Strengthening and Capacity Building Component offers ₹14,00,00,00,000/- for training, community mobilization, and the procurement of equipment such
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must reside or operate within the identified water-stressed districts, blocks, or Gram Panchayats selected for the scheme. - The applicant must be located in one of the seven participating states, namely Gujarat, Haryana, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, or Uttar Pradesh. - The applicant must formulate a Water Security Plan with active community participation. - The applicant must obtain the final approval of the prepared Water Security Plan from the Gram Sabha. - The applicant must ensure the presence of at least 33% female members in the Gram Panchayat-level Water User Associations or Village Water and Sanitation Committees. - The applicant should identify and train local volunteers or community resource persons to handle data collection equipment.
